_comment: CI-only Capacitor config, copied into assets/public's sibling slot next to
file in CI: `npx cap update` writes capacitor.plugins.json only, and `cap
copy` — which would write the real config from capacitor.config.ts — never
runs because CI does not build the Angular app.
It exists for one reason: loggingBehavior defaults to 'debug', which means
CapConfig sets loggingEnabled = FLAG_DEBUGGABLE. The r8Test APK is
`initWith release` and therefore not debuggable, so Capacitor drops every
console message — including the SP_SMOKE markers the smoke greps for. With
the default config the smoke could only ever time out.
Nothing else here has to match capacitor.config.ts: plugin registration
comes from capacitor.plugins.json, and the smoke uses the default scheme
